requirements.requirement: Sample sizes for every cohort summary
assertions: Independent source audits checked included, eligible, nullified, penalized, boundary and scouting counts with denominators overall and by game, offense and coverage for 321 included plays and four exclusions.

Personnel, play action, dropback, box count, scores and protection fields preserve missing values separately from false. All 321 context objects and 7383 player protection objects matched raw source CSVs.
Acceleration and displacement follow the original five track values at indices 5 and 6. Independent Decimal-based parity checked all 1962429 replay and pre-snap motion values.

Synthetic tests and independent raw recomputation passed for speed, position-jump and speed/displacement diagnostics. Coordinates remain unclamped; thresholds are explicitly heuristic rather than calibrated error bounds.
Per-player scouting availability, missing IDs, unknown roles and role counts are explicit. Missing-scouting fixtures and complete raw role parity passed.
Frame diagnostics preserve contradictory event tags and missing-tag counts. Independent audit matched every exported event and agreement diagnostic, with explicit snap and first pass-forward cutoffs.

All 325 selected source plays are accounted for: 321 included and four excluded with source-supported reasons. Overall and grouped exclusion denominators were independently checked; unsupported future exclusion reasons fail closed.
Separate preSnap arrays retain 2023 observed frames without shifting post-snap indices. All 46529 pre-snap player/ball observations matched raw CSVs.

Join report has 321 matched plays, 252 mapped target IDs and no unresolved targets. Python integrity tests passed. The normalized-export browser regression passed exact known-file hash trust, removal of forged outcomes from edited bytes, dataset workspace isolation and exact-identity mismatch rejection, with zero JavaScript errors or external requests.

Eight Python schema tests and three Python/browser parity tests passed. Validators enforce finite values, identities, roles, geometry, aligned timelines, metric consistency and known optional context; legacy five-value tracks remain accepted.
Required and duplicate headers, malformed row widths, blank keys and duplicate primary keys are checked. Ingestion rejection fixtures and the independent raw CSV reader passed.

Revision-scoped cache files match existing immutable manifest hashes; corrupt files require refresh. Corruption, refresh and bounded-retry tests passed. Both regenerated source-audit reports pass and match final LF-normalized data, auditor and source-manifest hashes.

Modified local CSVs are marked unverified and cannot claim a pinned sourceRevision. Local-override tests passed; normalized-export browser checks prove unknown edited bytes lose pinned revision and external outcomes. Both current source-audit reports pass.

requirements.requirement: Atomic artifact writes and pairing checks
assertions: Staged/flushed writes roll back ordinary replacement failures; buildId and dataset SHA detect mismatched pairs. Two files are not claimed to be one crash-atomic operation. Pairing/export regressions passed and both normalized data/provenance pairs pass current independent audits.
Downloads have bounded retries, a timeout, size limit, progress callbacks and temporary-file cleanup; only selected games download. Transient failure, retry bound and refresh tests passed.

requirements.requirement: Maintainable modular frontend with single-file export
assertions: Maintained frontend modules embed into a single offline HTML file. Four submission tests passed, covering safe embedding, offline export and actual HTTP startup.

Workflow configures Python, shared JavaScript checks, Chromium/Firefox verification and release artifacts. Local browser evidence exists; final workflow integration and hosted CI execution are not claimed as already passed.

requirements.requirement: Shared numerical regressions and Python/JS parity
assertions: Seventeen synthetic fixtures and two real-play cases compare complete Python/JavaScript result objects. The current 20-test metric suite passed, including minimum-hold and cross-runtime parity regressions.

requirements.requirement: Reproducible versioned releases and native-resolution exports
assertions: Release builder uses fixed ZIP timestamps and a per-file SHA-256 manifest; images and clips render directly at 2000 by 1500 pixels. Native export flows passed. Independent clean-commit verification produced byte-identical archives, verified every manifest checksum, regenerated identical offline HTML and passed all 91 packaged tests available without the two optional raw-CSV caches. Final delivery records its own commit and archive checksum.

requirements.requirement: Decomposition identity on synthetic and real geometries
assertions: Coverage Lift plus receiver movement equals net separation change on synthetic, randomized and real geometries. The 20-test metric suite passed; the real-data validator fails violated identities and records residuals.

Executed counterexamples distinguish receiver-only and defender-only motion, common translation, replacement coverage, nearest switches, missing observations, history gaps and scope entry. Shared numerical parity passed.

Threshold/lookback comparisons and deterministic coordinate jitter are implemented. Reproducible-jitter and zero-amplitude identity tests passed; outputs explicitly are not confidence intervals or calibrated error estimates.
